name: Mute Whites
description: Inverts and slightly dims a page; images and video keep their colours. One click switches a site on and remembers it, the next click switches it off. No network, nothing runs on sites you did not switch on.

browser_action.default_title: Mute Whites: click to switch this site on or off (Alt+Shift+M)

toggle.description: Switch the current site on or off
